research_mode: official Police.uk sources only; category versioning, availability, street-query and error-boundary controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Crime-category date versioning
verified_claims: valid crime categories are returned for a specified dataset month
limitations: category identifiers must be pinned to the requested month

sources.name: Crime-category URL identifier
verified_claims: the url field is the category identifier used by API methods
limitations: the human-readable name is not a stable request key

sources.name: All-crime category scope
verified_claims: all-crime is labelled All crime and ASB
limitations: all-crime must not be interpreted as notifiable crime only

sources.name: Street-data availability months
verified_claims: availability returns ISO year-month values for published street data
limitations: available month does not guarantee every force supplied every data type

sources.name: Monthly stop-search force list
verified_claims: each month includes force IDs that supplied stop-and-search data
limitations: absence from the list is missing supply, not zero searches

sources.name: Latest-month default
verified_claims: street crime defaults to the latest available month when date is omitted
limitations: implicit latest-month requests are not reproducible without recording the resolved month

sources.name: Street crime point radius
verified_claims: point queries cover crimes within approximately one mile of the supplied coordinate
limitations: the response is contextual and not a parcel-radius measurement

sources.name: Custom polygon closure
verified_claims: first and last polygon coordinates need not match because the API closes them with a straight line
limitations: implicit closure can create an unintended final edge

sources.name: Custom-area volume ceiling
verified_claims: custom areas containing more than 10000 crimes return HTTP 503
limitations: 503 at this boundary is not evidence of no data

sources.name: GET request length ceiling
verified_claims: GET requests longer than 4094 characters return HTTP 400
limitations: complex polygons should use POST rather than truncation

sources.name: Complex polygon POST fallback
verified_claims: POST is recommended for particularly complex polygon parameters
limitations: method change must preserve the same polygon and month inputs

sources.name: Street-crime category path
verified_claims: crime category is supplied as part of the request path
limitations: the category must be valid for the requested dataset date

sources.name: Street-crime context field
verified_claims: context contains extra crime information when applicable
limitations: empty context must not be treated as missing crime

sources.name: Street outcome latest-only field
verified_claims: outcome_status reports the latest recorded outcome category and date
limitations: it is not the full case history

sources.name: Null latest outcome
verified_claims: street responses can contain null outcome_status
limitations: null does not prove that no outcome will ever exist
